item.title: On the Bookshelf: How to Feed the World
item.description: Added to Bookshelf: my April 10, 2025 review of Vaclav Smil’s How to Feed the World. Reading from within organic agriculture, I explore nutrients, energy, scale, and the overlooked costs behind food-system solutions. Includes the original Medium review and a connection to The Pathology of More.

item.title: On the Bookshelf: soil, community, and work
item.description: Reading notes on The Farm Is Here by Jeff Tkach, plus James Suzman’s Work and his talk on how work has shaped society.

item.title: 001 — The machines were never the whole story.
item.description: From Smith’s pin factory to AI: a visual exploration of automation, economics, and who gets the gains. Includes historical perspectives, charts, an interactive productivity experiment, and sourced explorations of Newton, cognitive offloading, meaningful work, and the freedom to pursue new questions. Includes a companion video with James Suzman.
